notes.title: Wonders of Wizardry Sale and v1.1 Patch!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone


We're happy to announce our participation in Wonders of Wizardry Festival! with ethe extended launch sale of 20%.



Patch v1.1:

Increased portal travel time to decrease unwanted ending of the level.

Fixed that sometimes items sold from the inventory at the end of the round doesn't get added to the total gold.

Small balances to projectiles and monsters.



Thanks everyone for the support and playing the game!
- Knight Owl Games

notes.title: Wandness v1.0 Release!!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973540/74fe22bb2f2b6c3e15ae15270f9a9a47702668be.png"]
Hello Wizards!
We are thrilled to announce that The Wandness: WandCraft Survivor is coming to 1.0



The full game includes the following content:

12+ Characters

2 Game modes + Leaderboard

10+ projectiles

8+ wand elements

8+ wand classes

30+ wand components

This update brings you a wealth of fantastic new additions and thoughtful balance adjustments!





Thank you for your invaluable suggestions and encouragement throughout development! Grab your wands – your magical adventure begins now!

- Knight Owl Games 🦉

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch v0.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We just have a quick QOL Patch, thanks for your feedback :)

-You can see your wands in the pause & game over panels.
(make sure to share your build on our Discord server)

- Added Hit effect when the player is hit
- You can highlight affected wands by hovering over the Wand element or class
- You can swipe wands between each others
- Added Pause \ Unpause all wands button 
- Map events size is bigger 
- Balances for enemies and projectiles
- Fixed Minor bugs

Your feedback is really important to us. You can join our Discord server to share yours.

If you enjoy this demo of the game, don't forget to Wishlist the game
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928690
